title: cut-surface.md calls its refusal list exhaustive, but ALL_VARIANTS names only FacadeError's own variants, so a refusal the facade does not wrap, or one inside a type it wraps, is absent
body:
## What

`docs/reference/cut-surface.md` calls its refusal list exhaustive, but the roster it reads lists only `FacadeError`'s variants. So a refusal the CLI renders outside the facade never appears in it. ic measured this on 2026-10-22, regenerating the reference set for the 3.2.5 cut at 02fc792f4 against v3.2.4 (de5fc7b75), after vc expected the train's new refusals to show and they did not:

- The page's `## Refusals` section says "The refusal variants declared at this revision, from `ALL_VARIANTS` in `native/rust/crates/intentsvcs/tests/error_remedies.rs`", and that the list "comes from a roster that declares itself exhaustive and is checked as one". `gen_cut_surface.sh`'s header says the same.
- `ALL_VARIANTS` (error_remedies.rs:1261) is the roster of `FacadeError`'s own variants, named through `fn variant(err: &FacadeError)`. Thirteen of them wrap another error type: twelve through `#[from]` (eg `Install(InstallError)`, `Store(StoreError)`, `Git(GitStateError)`), plus `Canon(CanonError)`. Each wrapper is one entry, as in `FacadeError::Install(_) => "Install"`. So the list names a wrapped type once and none of that type's own refusals, and an error type the facade does not wrap is not in it at all.
- Issue 0609 (1de4bcf0a) added a refusal for a bare git repository in three types the facade does not wrap: `InitError::BareRepository(PathBuf)` (init.rs:207), `ProjectError::BareRepository(String)` (project.rs:1208) and `projects::Refusal::BareRepository` (projects.rs:321). render.rs:8824 renders `InitError`'s directly as a failure. Driven on the pair at 8bef2bb7a in a scratch bare repository, `intent init` exits 1 with "error: <path> is a bare git repository, which has no working tree to hold a project" and writes nothing. `ALL_VARIANTS` is unchanged from v3.2.4 to HEAD, and the page does not list that refusal.
- Issue 0610's new anchor refusal is not a gap: it reuses `FacadeError::WbNoSuchMessage`, which the list carries.

Not measured: the whole set of error types the CLI renders as refusals without passing through `FacadeError`. The three above were measured and the rest were not enumerated. Nor were the refusals inside each wrapped type that the list collapses into one entry.

## Expected

The page's list and its claim agree. Either the roster covers every refusal the CLI renders, the wrapped types' own variants and the unwrapped types included, checked the way `ALL_VARIANTS` is checked, or the page says the list is the facade's top-level variants and names what it leaves out. Until then the page ships as-built, under decision 33.

Found by ic at the 3.2.5 cut's reference regeneration. Filed by ic on vc's word.

## Spec (vc, 2026-10-23, under hv's go)

LANE: ic, S. SHAPE: the page's `## Refusals` preamble and `gen_cut_surface.sh`'s header stop calling the list exhaustive. They say it is `FacadeError`'s top-level variants as `ALL_VARIANTS` names them; that a wrapped type (eg Install, Store, Git, Canon) appears once and its own refusals do not; and that an error type the facade does not wrap is absent, with 0609's three `BareRepository` refusals as the named example. The roster is not widened: widening it is new surface and sits behind the line. PROOF: the generator's text and the page's text say the same thing, so a regeneration at the cut reproduces the page. If a regeneration now would change anything beyond those sentences, the sentences change in the generator and in the page by hand and the full regeneration stays the cut's, said so in the commit. CLOSES WHEN: the commit lands on main and `intent issues close 0622` names its sha.
